name: brieflee
description: Ask ChatGPT about your Brieflee meetings, tasks and decisions.

interface.longDescription:
Brieflee records your meetings on Teams, Google Meet and Zoom and writes a report for each one. This plugin lets ChatGPT read the meetings in your own Brieflee account: it can search them, open a meeting's report or transcript, and list your tasks and the decisions your meetings made.

It only reads. It cannot change anything in Brieflee, spend your credits or see meetings that are not yours. You sign in with your Brieflee account the first time, and you can disconnect at any time in Brieflee under Settings, Integrations, AI assistants.

You need a Brieflee account with meetings in it.
defaultPrompt: What did we decide in my last meeting?
Which tasks from my meetings are still open?

positive.description: Lists the meetings in the account.
positive.prompt: Which meetings do I have in Brieflee?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the three sample meetings, newest first, with their dates: Whitfield & Rowe: Litigation paralegal hiring, then Grandview Hotel: Lobby renovation progress, then Northline Freight: Warehouse contract renewal.

positive.prompt: What did we decide about the Northline Freight warehouse contract?
positive.tools_triggered: search or list_meetings, then get_report or list_decisions
positive.expected_behavior: Says the contract is renewed for 24 months at 4 percent above the current rate, fixed for the whole term; a three-month Saturday morning trial shift (8 until 1) starts on the first of next month; the cold-store bay racking is replaced before the trial. Mentions that Saturday insurance cover is still open.

positive.description: Lists open tasks with owners and due dates.
positive.prompt: Which tasks from my meetings are still open, and who owns each one?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open tasks from the three meetings with an owner, a due date where one was said, and the meeting each came from. Examples: Priya Shah sends the revised contract by Friday; Tom Avery gets two quotes for the curved front desk; Aisha Khan calls Ana Morales with the offer by Thursday.

positive.description: Summarises one meeting from its report.
positive.prompt: Summarise the Grandview Hotel lobby renovation meeting.
positive.expected_behavior: Says the work is one week behind because of water damage in the old ceiling; a weekend crew (about 6,000 dollars from the 20,000 contingency) keeps the reopening on the fifteenth; the flooring changes from marble to porcelain tile; the curved front desk waits for two quotes; the fire inspection is booked for the week of the eighth.

positive.prompt: In the paralegal hiring meeting, what exactly did James Rowe say about Ben Carter?
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes James Rowe: Ben was pleasant but could not explain how he would organise a trial bundle, and James would not take him forward. Gives the line it comes from, and may add that the panel offered the role to Ana Morales at 56,000.

negative.description: General advice about meetings needs none of the person's own meetings.
negative.prompt: Give me five tips for running a shorter weekly team meeting.

negative.description: Writing a new document from scratch is not reading meetings.
negative.prompt: Write a job advert for a litigation paralegal at a law firm in London.

negative.description: A question about the world, not about the person's meetings.
negative.prompt: What is the difference between porcelain and ceramic floor tiles?

publication.release_notes: First release. Ask ChatGPT about the meetings in your own Brieflee account: search them, read a meeting's report or transcript, and list your open tasks and the decisions your meetings made. Read only: it cannot change anything in Brieflee, spend credits or see anyone else's meetings.
